## Summary (DRY RUN — all orders intercepted/logged, not live)

**Starting state:** No open positions, no open orders, $100,000 equity → position cap set at $2,500–$3,000 debit each (2.5–3%), max 6–8 concurrent calendars.

**Scanned:** All 12 Tier‑A candidates from today's list, in batches of 2–3, pulling live OPRA quotes for the exact ATM contracts at the scan's specified front (2026‑09‑04) / back (2026‑09‑25) expiries to confirm real tradeable pricing and liquidity before sizing.

**Opened 7 calendar spreads** (sell front ATM call / buy back ATM call, net debit), all at ~2.5–3% of equity:

| Ticker | Strike | Qty | Net debit/ctr | $ Debit | % Equity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SNOW | 322.5/325 | 10 | $2.60 | $2,600 | 2.60% |
| ZS | 187.5 | 9 | $3.20 | $2,880 | 2.88% |
| DOCU | 63.5/64 | 40 | $0.66 | $2,640 | 2.64% |
| MDT | 91 | 45 | $0.61 | $2,745 | 2.75% |
| MDB | 435 | 4 | $6.31 | $2,524 | 2.52% |
| AVGO | 370 | 5 | $5.28 | $2,640 | 2.64% |
| LULU | 119 | 14 | $1.92 | $2,688 | 2.69% |

Total capital at risk (max loss, capped by debit): ~$18,717, ~18.7% of equity across 7 defined-risk positions — no single name repeated, no margin exposure beyond the debit paid.

**Skipped: IOT** — despite a strong ratio (1.52) and candidate=true, the live front-month ATM call (IOT260904C00042000) showed a bid size of only 3 contracts against an ask size of 47 — a badly one-sided, thin book on exactly the leg we need to sell into. That's the kind of "looks fine on ratio, ugly on execution" case the liquidity rule is meant to catch, so I passed rather than forcing a fill at a bad price. Filled the cap out instead with the next-ranked names (AVGO, LULU) that had clean two-sided quotes.

**Not traded — correctly, by rule:**
- **DELL, PANW, HPE, CIEN** — all Tier A candidate=true with decent ratios (1.37–1.46), but the position cap (7 filled, within the 6–8 band) was reached first. No liquidity or sizing issue with these; they're simply next in line if the cap were raised or a position gets closed/rolled.
- No Tier B tickers were in this candidate list, so no control-group names needed flagging today.

**Rolling:** Nothing to roll yet — this is the first batch, all fresh opens with front legs 8 DTE. Will need front-leg rolls as we approach ~2 days to the 2026‑09‑04 expiry, or sooner if a name's earnings print lands and front IV visibly collapses toward the back leg's level first.

**Sizing logic:** Used live mid-quotes (not the scan's slightly stale mids) to compute the actual net debit, then chose the highest whole-contract quantity that keeps total debit inside the 2.5–3% band — leaning toward the top of the band per the sizing rule rather than under-sizing.
